name: Example CSV tag-list importer (template)
description: Template importer: converts CSV tag lists (name,type,initial,comment) into IEC 61131-3 VAR_GLOBAL declarations. Copy and rename it to start your own importer.

coverageNotes: Elementary types only (BOOL, integer, bit-string, REAL/LREAL, time/date and STRING types); no arrays, structs or FB instances.
Initial values must be single literals; legacy octal literals are upgraded to hex.
